docs.title: Mixer User Guide
docs.text:
Welcome to the Mixer App!

Welcome to the user guide for your Mixer machine. This documentation will help you set up and use your machine to create perfect mixes every time.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
• Home Screen Dashboard - Overview of the central control panel.
  • Setting Up Your Mixer - A step-by-step guide on how to prepare your machine for the first time.
  • Pots Management - How to manage ingredients and monitor pot status.
  • Recipes and Dispensing - How to select and make your favorite mixes.

docs.title: Support
docs.text: For more help, please contact our support team or visit our website.

docs.title: Binding and Unbinding Ingredients
docs.text:
1. Open the Pots screen.
  2. Tap a pot with no ingredient assigned.
  3. Select an ingredient from the available materials list.

docs.title: Unbinding an Ingredient
docs.text:
1. Open the Pots screen.

docs.title: Cleaning Module Documentation
docs.text: This document provides an overview and user guide for the Cleaning Module of the Mixer application. The cleaning module ensures that the beverage dispensing pipes and pots are maintained in a hygienic state.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: The Cleaning Module allows users to perform routine and deep cleaning of the machine's dispensing channels (pots). It tracks the last cleaning time for each pot and provides a guided multi-step deep cleaning process.

docs.title: 1. Cleaning Status Dashboard
docs.text: The main cleaning screen displays all pots and their current cleaning status: - Pot Information: Displays pot number and the name of the assigned ingredient. - Last Cleaned Timestamp: Shows the exact date and time the pot was last cleaned. - Status Indicators: - Green: Cleaned within the last 24 hours. - Orange/Warning: Not cleaned for more than 24 hours. - Red/Danger: Never cleaned or needs immediate attention.

docs.title: 2. Selection and Batch Cleaning
docs.text: Users can select individual pots or use the "Select All" feature to perform cleaning on multiple channels simultaneously.

docs.title: 3. Deep Cleaning Process
docs.text: Deep cleaning is a thorough sanitation process consisting of three main stages:

docs.title: Stage 1: Empty the Pipes (Rinse)
docs.text:
• Purpose: Uses warm water to rinse out any residual liquid from the pipes.
  • Adjustable Parameter: Flush Time (0 to 20 seconds).
  • Instruction: Add warm water into the pots before starting.

docs.title: Stage 2: Disinfection (Soak)
docs.text:
• Purpose: Uses disinfectant to soak the inner walls of the pipes to ensure thorough sanitation.
  • Adjustable Parameters:
  • Flush Time: Duration for initial disinfectant flow.
  • Soak Time: Duration the disinfectant remains in the pipes (up to 5 minutes).
  • Cycles: This step can be repeated multiple times for better results.

docs.title: Stage 3: Final Rinse
docs.text:
• Purpose: Uses fresh drinking water to flush out any remaining disinfectant from the pipes.
  • Adjustable Parameter: Flush Time.

docs.title: How to start a Deep Clean
docs.text:
1. Navigate to the Cleaning tab from the main navigation.
  2. Select Pots: Tap on the pots you wish to clean. You can also use "Select All".
  3. Tap Start Cleaning.
  4. Step 0 (Empty Pipes):
  5. Fill the selected pots with warm water.
  6. Adjust the flush time if necessary.
  7. Tap Start.
  8. Wait for the countdown to finish.
  9. Step 1 (Deep Clean/Disinfection):
  10. Fill the selected pots with disinfectant solution.
  11. Adjust both Flush and Soak times.
  12. Tap Start [Cycle X].
  13. After a cycle finishes, you can tap Start [Cycle X+1] to repeat or Done to move to the final stage.
  14. Step 2 (Final Rinse):
  15. Fill the pots with fresh drinking water.
  16. Adjust the flush time.
  17. Tap Start.
  18. Completion: Once all steps are finished, the system will update the "Last Cleaned" timestamp for all selected pots.

docs.title: Safety & Maintenance Tips
docs.text:
• It is recommended to perform cleaning at least once every 24 hours to maintain beverage quality and hygiene.
  • Always ensure you have the appropriate cleaning agents (warm water, disinfectant, fresh water) ready for each step.
  • Do not interrupt the cleaning process unless necessary. If paused, remember to resume to ensure the cycle completes.

docs.title: Cleaning
docs.text:
1. Remove the scale handle and place a large container under the dispenser.
  2. Disconnect the pipes from the containers and place them in a large container of hot water.
  3. Open the Pots screen.
  4. Tap Select in the footer.
  5. Select the pots you want to clean. Use the top tab navigator to identify pots that have not been cleaned and need cleaning.
  6. Tap Clean.
  7. In the Empty Pipe step, choose a duration or use the default, then tap Start.
  8. Wait for the Empty Pipe step to finish.
  9. Make sure the container under the dispenser is empty. Replace the hot water in the container holding the pipes with hot water and the required cleaning fluids.
  10. Choose the dispense and soak durations, then tap Start.
  11. After the Soak step finishes, repeat it one more time or finish the cleaning process. Perform this step once each morning for daily cleaning, or repeat it multiple times for a weekly deep clean.
  12. In the final Empty Pipe step, remove the container under the dispenser and replace the water in the hot-water container with hot water.
  13. Choose the duration and tap Start.
  14. Wait for the cleaning process to finish.

docs.title: Using a QR Code
docs.text:
1. Place a cup under the dispenser.
  2. Scan the QR code containing recipe and its specifications.
  3. Wait for the dispensing process to finish automatically.
  4. Check the completion summary.

docs.title: Using the Recipe Page
docs.text:
1. Open Recipes.
  2. Select a recipe.
  3. Select the specifications.
  4. Place a cup under the dispenser.
  5. Tap Dispense.
  6. Wait for the dispensing process to finish.
  7. Check the completion summary.

docs.title: Filling and Initiating Containers
docs.text:
1. Refill the pot with the required fluid.
  2. Place a large cup under the dispenser.
  3. Open the Pots screen.
  4. Tap the Menu icon (three vertical dots) on the pot.

  5. Select Refill.

  6. Tap Top Up.

  7. Wait for the brief initialization to finish, if it starts.

docs.title: Refilling Multiple Pots
docs.text:
1. Refill the pots with the required fluids.
  2. Place a large cup under the dispenser.
  3. Open the Pots screen.
  4. Tap Select in the footer.

  5. Select the pots you refilled.

  6. Tap Refill.

  7. Wait for the pots to initiate one by one.

  8. Confirm the process.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: Follow these steps to prepare the pots and dispense a recipe.

docs.title: Before You Begin
docs.text: 1. Make sure the machine is connected to the network and the empty scale shows 0.

docs.title: Bind an Ingredient
docs.text:
1. Open the Pots screen.
  2. Tap a pot with no ingredient assigned.
  3. Select an ingredient from the available materials list.
  4. Confirm that the ingredient name appears on the pot.

docs.title: Fill and Initiate a Pot
docs.text:
1. Tap the Menu icon (three vertical dots) on the pot.
  2. Select Refill.
  3. Adjust the slider to the new total volume.
  4. Tap Top Up.
  5. Wait for the brief initialization to finish, if it starts.

docs.title: Dispensing by Recipe
docs.text:
1. Open Recipes.
  2. Select a recipe.
  3. Select the specifications.
  4. Check that the ingredients are available and the dispensers are calibrated.
  5. Place a cup under the dispenser.
  6. Tap Dispense.
  7. Wait for the dispensing process to finish.
  8. Check the completion summary.

docs.title: User Guide: Home Screen Dashboard
docs.text: The Home screen provides an overview of the machine status, activity, and maintenance needs.

docs.title: 1. Usage Statistics
docs.text:
Summarizes machine performance and maintenance needs.

  • Calibration Needed: Shows pots requiring calibration.
  • Today's Orders: Shows recipes successfully produced today.
  • This Week (Failed): Shows failed production attempts this week.
  • This Week (Success): Shows successful productions this week.

docs.title: 2. Recent Recipes & Activity
docs.text:
Lists recent production records.

  • Shows the recipe, target volume, weight error, order ID, status, and start time.
  • Tap a recipe to open its details.

docs.title: 3. Low/Empty Pots Management
docs.text:
Shows low or empty ingredient pots.

  • Low ingredients: Lists pots below 1500 ml or empty.
  • Refilling: Tap an ingredient to open the refill interface.

Tip: Check the Hardware Status panel first when a red hardware warning appears.

docs.title: Setting Up Your Mixer
docs.text: This guide will help you through the first-time setup of your Mixer machine. The setup wizard is designed to prepare the machine for use, ensuring everything is calibrated and ready to go.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The setup process is a simple, step-by-step guide. When you begin, the machine will reset to its factory state: - Any current user will be signed out. - Previous settings will be cleared. - All ingredient containers will be reset. - The recipe list will be refreshed.

The guide consists of several easy steps.

docs.title: 1. Connect and Identify
docs.text:
The first step is to connect your machine to the internet and identify it.

Scan the QR code on the back or side of your machine.

  • Wi-Fi Connection: Make sure your machine is connected to a reliable Wi-Fi network.
  • Scanning: Use the app to scan the QR code on your machine. This helps the app recognize your specific device.
  • Registration: The app will automatically register your machine with our service.
  • Checking Components: The machine will perform a quick check of its internal parts, like the scanner and pumps.
  • Loading Data: Your machine will download the latest configuration and available ingredients.

docs.title: 2. Scale Calibration
docs.text:
Next, you will be guided through making sure the built-in scale is accurate.

The scale calibration screen.

  • Accuracy Check: This step ensures that the scale measures ingredients correctly.
  • Zeroing: You'll be asked to make sure the scale reads zero when empty.
  • Weight Check: You might be asked to place a known weight to confirm accuracy.
  • Next Step: Once the scale is accurate, you can move to the next part.

docs.title: 3. Pump Calibration
docs.text:
This step ensures that the machine dispenses the exact amount of each ingredient.

Testing each pump for accuracy.

  • Dispensing Accuracy: Each pump is tested to make sure it delivers the right amount of liquid.
  • Validation: You will confirm that each ingredient container is ready and calibrated.
  • Ready to Use: Once confirmed, your machine is officially set up and ready to use! You will be taken to your main Dashboard.

docs.title: Finishing Setup
docs.text:
Once you finish the pump calibration:

Your machine's main dashboard.

  1. Your machine is marked as "Ready."
  2. You will be taken to your Dashboard, where you can start making recipes!

docs.title: Machine Testing Checklist
docs.text: Complete this checklist before sending the machine to the store.

docs.title: Pots
docs.text:
• Bind an ingredient to a pot and confirm that the ingredient is shown.
  • Open the pot menu, select Unbind Pot, and confirm that the ingredient is removed.
  • Calibrate each pot and confirm that the calibration is complete.

docs.title: Machine Components
docs.text:
• Test the screen and confirm that it responds to touch.
  • Test the network connection.
  • Test the scale and confirm that it reads weight correctly.
  • Test the scanner.
  • Test the sound.
  • Test the heater, if installed.
  • Run the motors and confirm stable operation.

docs.title: Recipes and Accuracy
docs.text:
• Dispense multiple recipes and confirm that each recipe completes successfully.
  • Check the dispensed amount for each recipe against its required specification and confirm the accuracy.

docs.title: Refill
docs.text:
• Refill a pot and confirm that the refill process completes successfully.
  • Confirm that the machine is ready before sending it to the store.

docs.title: Manual Dispensing
docs.text:
You can manually dispense a specific amount of an ingredient.

  1. Open the Pots screen.
  2. Tap the pot you want to dispense. The pot details open in the sidebar.
  3. Select or enter the desired amount in grams (g).
  4. Place a cup under the dispenser.
  5. Tap Dispense.
  6. Monitor the real-time dispensing weight and the final accuracy summary.
  7. Tap Stop if you need to interrupt the process.

docs.title: Pots Management Documentation
docs.text: The Pots Management feature allows you to monitor and manage the ingredients stored in the machine's individual containers (pots). Each pot is assigned a number and can be linked to a specific ingredient, heated, and manually dispensed.

docs.title: 📋 Overview of Pots
docs.text: The Pots screen displays all available containers. Each pot card shows: - Pot Number: The unique identifier for the container. - Ingredient Name: The name of the linked ingredient (if assigned). - Fill Level: The current volume in milliliters (ml). - Temperature: Current and target temperature (if heating is active). - Status Badges: Indicators for calibration status (e.g., "Uncalibrated", "Stale") or expiration.

docs.title: 🔗 Binding and Unbinding Ingredients
docs.text: To use a pot, it must be "bound" to an ingredient from the system's material list.

docs.title: Binding a Pot
docs.text:
1. Tap an empty pot (or a pot with no ingredient assigned).
  2. A list of available materials/ingredients will appear.
  3. Select the ingredient you wish to link to this pot.
  4. The pot will now display the ingredient name and default expiration settings.

docs.title: Unbinding a Pot
docs.text:
1. Tap the Menu icon (three vertical dots) on a pot card.
  2. Select Unbind Pot.
  3. Confirm the action. This will clear the ingredient assignment and reset the fill level.

docs.title: 🌡️ Temperature Control
docs.text:
Pots will not heat up unless the temperature is manually set.

If a pot is equipped with a heater, you can control its temperature.

  1. Tap the Temperature icon on the pot card (or access it via the Pot Menu).
  2. Use the slider to set the desired temperature (typically between 10°C and 40°C).
  3. Tap Set to start heating.
  4. You can monitor the "Current Temperature" in real-time.
  5. Tap Stop at any time to turn off the heater.

docs.title: 💧 Refilling and Depleting Pots
docs.text: The slider shows the current fill level in milliliters (ml). Keep track of the ingredient levels to ensure the machine can complete recipes.

docs.title: Refilling (Top Up)
docs.text:
1. Tap the Menu icon and select Refill (or tap the pot if the fill level is critically low).
  2. Adjust the slider to reflect the new total volume in the pot.
  3. Tap Top Up to save the changes. The machine may perform a brief initialization.

docs.title: Depleting (Clear)
docs.text:
1. Tap the Menu icon and select Clear.
  2. This will reset the pot's current fill level to 0ml, indicating it is empty.

docs.title: ⚖️ Calibration and Maintenance
docs.text:
Accurate dispensing depends on proper calibration.

  • Calibrate: If a pot shows "Uncalibrated", you must perform a calibration process (accessible via the Menu) to ensure accurate measurements.
  • Recalculate Regression: Advanced maintenance option to refine dispensing accuracy based on historical data.
  • Reset Errors: If a pot has encountered multiple dispensing errors, you can clear the error history via the Menu once the issue is resolved.

docs.title: 🧪 Manual Dispensing
docs.text:
The slider shows the current fill level in milliliters (ml).

Shows the current weight being dispensed in grams (g).

The final summary of the dispensing process.

You can manually dispense a specific amount of an ingredient for testing or custom use.

  1. Tap the main body of a bound pot card to open the Pot Details screen.
  2. Select or enter the desired amount in grams (g).
  3. Ensure a cup is placed under the dispenser.
  4. Tap Dispense.
  5. The screen will show the real-time weight being dispensed and a final summary of accuracy.
  6. Use the Stop button if you need to interrupt the process.

docs.title: Recipes and Dispensing Guide
docs.text: This guide explains how to use the Recipes and Dispensing features in the Mixer application.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: The Recipes feature allows you to browse available recipes, select specific versions or sizes, and start the automatic dispensing process.

docs.title: Recipe List
docs.text:
The main screen shows all available recipes.

List of all available recipes.

  • Categories: Use the tabs at the top to filter recipes by category.
  • Recipe Cards: Each recipe shows its name, a unique code, and its type.
  • Check Availability: Use the "Check Availability" button to see which recipes can be made with the ingredients currently loaded in the machine.

docs.title: Recipe Details
docs.text:
Selecting a recipe shows more information and options for preparation.

Recipe details and version selection screen.

docs.title: 1. Version Selection
docs.text: Many recipes have different variants or sizes. You can select the one you need, and the required ingredients and total weight will update automatically.

docs.title: 2. Ingredient Status
docs.text: The app will warn you if: - Any ingredients are missing. - There isn't enough of an ingredient left. - The machine's dispensers need calibration.

docs.title: 3. Ingredients List
docs.text: You can see all the ingredients required and the exact amount needed for the selected version.

docs.title: 4. Starting the Process
docs.text:
• Start Dispense: This begins the automatic mixing and dispensing process.
  • Mode Selection: Depending on the machine setup, you might be able to choose between a "Quick" or "Standard" dispensing mode.

docs.title: The Dispensing Process
docs.text:
While the machine is working, you can see real-time progress on the screen. The machine handles the precise measurement of each ingredient. If any issues occur, like a pump problem or an ingredient running out, the app will notify you immediately.

Real-time progress while the machine is dispensing.

docs.title: Results and Completion
docs.text:
Once the process is finished, a summary will appear: - Status: Confirms if the process was successful. - Weight Accuracy: Shows how much was actually dispensed compared to the target weight. - Automatic Logging: The machine automatically records the production data for your records.

Completion summary showing results and weight accuracy.

docs.title: Temperature Control
docs.text:
If a pot is equipped with a heater, you can control its temperature.

  1. Tap the Temperature icon on the pot card, or access it through the Pot Menu.
  2. Use the slider to set the desired temperature, typically between 10°C and 40°C.

  3. Tap Set to start heating.

  4. Monitor the Current Temperature in real time.

  5. Tap Stop at any time to turn off the heater.

docs.title: Mixer 用户指南
docs.text:
欢迎使用 Mixer 应用！

欢迎使用 Mixer 机器用户指南。本文档将帮助您设置并使用您的机器，每次都能调制出完美的饮品。

docs.title: 快速入门
docs.text:
• 主屏幕仪表板 - 中央控制面板概述。
  • 设置您的 Mixer - 关于如何首次准备机器的分步指南。
  • 容器管理 - 如何管理原料并监控容器状态。
  • 配方和出料 - 如何选择并制作您最喜欢的混合饮品。

docs.title: 支持
docs.text: 如需更多帮助，请联系我们的支持团队或访问我们的网站。

docs.title: 将原料绑定到容器
docs.text:
1. 打开容器页面。
  2. 点击空容器，或尚未分配原料的容器。
  3. 从可用原料列表中选择原料。
  4. 确认容器上显示原料名称。

docs.title: 解除原料绑定
docs.text:
1. 打开容器页面。
  2. 点击容器旁边的菜单图标（三个竖点）。

  3. 选择解除容器绑定。

  4. 确认操作。

docs.title: 清洗模块文档
docs.text: 本文档提供 Mixer 应用程序清洗模块的概述和用户指南。清洗模块确保饮料分配管道和容器（Pots）保持卫生状态。

docs.title: 概述
docs.text: 清洗模块允许用户对机器的分配通道（Pots）进行日常和深度清洗。它跟踪每个 Pot 的最后清洗时间，并提供引导式的多步骤深度清洗流程。

docs.title: 1. 清洗状态仪表板
docs.text: 主清洗屏幕显示所有 Pot 及其当前清洗状态： - Pot 信息： 显示 Pot 编号和分配的原料名称。 - 上次清洗时间戳： 显示 Pot 上次清洗的具体日期和时间。 - 状态指示器： - 绿色： 在过去 24 小时内清洗过。 - 橙色/警告： 超过 24 小时未清洗。 - 红色/危险： 从未清洗或需要立即处理。

docs.title: 2. 选择与批量清洗
docs.text: 用户可以选择单个 Pot 或使用“全选”功能同时对多个通道进行清洗。

docs.title: 3. 深度清洗流程
docs.text: 深度清洗是一个彻底的消毒过程，由三个主要阶段组成：

docs.title: 第 1 阶段：排空管道（冲洗）
docs.text:
• 目的： 使用温水冲洗掉管道中残留的液体。
  • 可调参数： 冲洗时间（0 到 20 秒）。
  • 说明： 在开始前向 Pot 中加入温水。

docs.title: 第 2 阶段：消毒（浸泡）
docs.text:
• 目的： 使用消毒剂浸泡管道内壁，确保彻底消毒。
  • 可调参数：
  • 冲洗时间： 初始消毒液流动的持续时间。
  • 浸泡时间： 消毒剂留在管道中的持续时间（最长 5 分钟）。
  • 循环： 此步骤可以重复多次以获得更好的效果。

docs.title: 第 3 阶段：最终冲洗
docs.text:
• 目的： 使用新鲜饮用水冲洗掉管道中残留的消毒剂。
  • 可调参数： 冲洗时间。

docs.title: 如何开始深度清洗
docs.text:
1. 从主导航栏导航到 清洗 (Cleaning) 选项卡。
  2. 选择 Pot： 点击您想要清洗的 Pot。您也可以使用“全选”。
  3. 点击 开始清洗。
  4. 第 0 步（排空管道）：
  5. 向选定的 Pot 中加入温水。
  6. 如有必要，调整冲洗时间。
  7. 点击 开始。
  8. 等待倒计时结束。
  9. 第 1 步（深度清洗/消毒）：
  10. 向选定的 Pot 中加入消毒液。
  11. 调整冲洗和浸泡时间。
  12. 点击 开始 [循环 X]。
  13. 一个循环结束后，您可以点击 开始 [循环 X+1] 重复，或点击 完成 进入最后阶段。
  14. 第 2 步（最终冲洗）：
  15. 向 Pot 中加入新鲜饮用水。
  16. 调整冲洗时间。
  17. 点击 开始。
  18. 完成： 所有步骤完成后，系统将更新所有选定 Pot 的“上次清洗”时间戳。

docs.title: 安全与维护提示
docs.text:
• 建议至少每 24 小时进行一次清洗，以保持饮料质量和卫生。
  • 始终确保为每个步骤准备好适当的清洁剂（温水、消毒剂、清水）。
  • 除非必要，请勿中断清洗过程。如果暂停，请记得恢复以确保循环完成。

docs.title: 清洗
docs.text:
1. 移除秤把手，并将大容器放在出料口下方。
  2. 将管道从容器上断开，并放入装有热水的大容器中。
  3. 打开容器页面。
  4. 点击底部的选择。
  5. 选择要清洗的容器。使用顶部标签导航器查看尚未清洗且需要清洗的容器。
  6. 点击清洗。
  7. 在排空管道步骤中选择时长或使用默认值，然后点击开始。
  8. 等待排空管道步骤完成。
  9. 确保出料口下方的容器为空。将装有管道的容器中的热水更换为热水和所需的清洗液。
  10. 选择出料时长和浸泡时长，然后点击开始。
  11. 浸泡步骤完成后，再重复一次或结束清洗流程。建议每天早上执行一次；每周深度清洗时重复多次。
  12. 在最后的排空管道步骤中，移走出料口下方的容器，并将热水容器中的水更换为热水。
  13. 选择时长，然后点击开始。
  14. 等待清洗流程完成。

docs.title: 使用二维码
docs.text:
1. 将杯子放在出料口下方。
  2. 扫描包含配方及其规格的二维码。
  3. 等待出料流程自动完成。
  4. 查看完成摘要。

docs.title: 使用配方页面
docs.text:
1. 打开配方。
  2. 选择配方。
  3. 选择所需规格。
  4. 将杯子放在出料口下方。

  5. 点击出料。

  6. 等待出料流程完成。

  7. 查看完成摘要。

docs.title: 填充和初始化容器
docs.text:
1. 用所需液体补充容器。
  2. 将大杯放在出料口下方。
  3. 打开容器页面。
  4. 点击容器上的菜单图标（三个竖点）。

  5. 选择补充。

  6. 将滑块调整到新的总容量。

  7. 点击加满。

docs.title: 补充多个容器
docs.text:
1. 用所需液体补充容器。
  2. 将大杯放在出料口下方。
  3. 打开容器页面。
  4. 点击底部的选择。

  5. 选择已补充的容器。

  6. 点击补充。

  7. 等待容器逐个初始化。

  8. 确认该流程。

docs.title: 入门指南
docs.text: 按照以下步骤准备容器并分配配方。

docs.title: 开始前
docs.text: 1. 确保机器已连接网络，并确认空秤显示为 0。

docs.title: 绑定原料
docs.text:
1. 打开容器页面。
  2. 点击未分配原料的容器。
  3. 从可用原料列表中选择原料。
  4. 确认容器上显示原料名称。

docs.title: 填充和初始化容器
docs.text:
1. 点击容器上的菜单图标（三个竖点）。
  2. 选择补充。
  3. 将滑块调整到新的总容量。
  4. 点击加满。
  5. 等待短暂的初始化完成（如开始初始化）。

docs.title: 出料
docs.text:
1. 打开配方。
  2. 选择配方。
  3. 选择所需规格。
  4. 检查原料是否可用，以及出料口是否已校准。
  5. 将杯子放在出料口下方。
  6. 点击出料。
  7. 等待出料流程完成。
  8. 查看完成摘要。

docs.title: 用户指南：主屏幕仪表板
docs.text: 主屏幕显示机器状态、近期活动和维护需求。

docs.title: 1. 机器信息
docs.text:
显示当前门店和机器信息。

  • 门店和机器信息：显示门店、设备型号、硬件版本和 PLC UUID。
  • 网络状态：WiFi 或互联网断开时显示警告。
  • 刷新：从服务器更新信息。

docs.title: 2. 硬件组件状态
docs.text:
显示关键硬件的状态和读数。

  • 秤：显示当前净重和在线状态。点击可校准或测试秤。
  • 电机：显示活动电机通道及连接状态。
  • 加热器：显示当前温度。
  • 扫描仪：显示扫描仪是否准备就绪。

docs.title: 3. 使用统计
docs.text:
汇总机器性能和维护需求。

  • 需要校准：显示需要校准的容器。
  • 今日订单：显示今天成功制作的配方。
  • 本周（失败）：显示本周失败的生产次数。
  • 本周（成功）：显示本周成功的生产次数。

docs.title: 4. 近期配方与活动
docs.text:
列出最近的生产记录。

  • 显示配方、目标体积、重量误差、订单 ID、状态和开始时间。
  • 点击配方可查看详情。

docs.title: 5. 低液位/空容器管理
docs.text:
显示液位较低或为空的原料容器。

  • 低原料：列出液位低于 1500 毫升或已空的容器。
  • 加料：点击原料打开加料界面。

提示：出现红色硬件警告时，先检查“硬件状态”面板。

docs.title: 设置您的 Mixer
docs.text: 本指南将帮助您完成 Mixer 机器的首次设置。设置向导旨在为使用机器做好准备，确保一切都经过校准并就绪。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
设置过程是一个简单的分步指南。开始时，机器将恢复到出厂状态： - 当前任何用户都将注销。 - 之前的设置将被清除。 - 所有原料容器将被重置。 - 配方列表将被刷新。

该指南包含几个简单的步骤。

docs.title: 1. 连接与识别
docs.text:
第一步是将您的机器连接到互联网并进行识别。

扫描机器背面或侧面的二维码。

  • Wi-Fi 连接：确保您的机器连接到可靠的 Wi-Fi 网络。
  • 扫描：使用应用扫描机器上的二维码。这有助于应用识别您的特定设备。
  • 注册：应用将自动在我们的服务中注册您的机器。
  • 检查组件：机器将对内部零件进行快速检查，例如扫描仪和泵。
  • 加载数据：您的机器将下载最新的配置和可用原料。

docs.title: 2. 秤校准
docs.text:
接下来，您将按照指引确保内置秤准确。

秤校准屏幕。

  • 准确性检查：此步骤确保秤能正确测量原料。
  • 归零：您将被要求确保秤在空载时读数为零。
  • 重量检查：您可能会被要求放置一个已知重量的物体以确认准确性。
  • 下一步：一旦秤准确，您就可以进行下一部分。

docs.title: 3. 泵校准
docs.text:
此步骤确保机器为每种原料出料准确的量。

测试每个泵的准确性。

  • 出料精度：测试每个泵以确保其输送正确数量的液体。
  • 验证：您将确认每个原料容器均已准备就绪并经过校准。
  • 准备就绪：确认后，您的机器正式设置完毕并可以开始使用！您将被带到主仪表板。

docs.title: 完成设置
docs.text:
完成泵校准后：

机器的主仪表板。

  1. 您的机器被标记为“就绪”。
  2. 您将被带到仪表板，在那里您可以开始制作配方！

docs.title: 机器测试清单
docs.text: 将机器送到门店前，完成以下清单。

docs.title: 容器
docs.text:
• 将原料绑定到容器，并确认容器显示原料名称。
  • 打开容器菜单，选择解绑容器，并确认原料已移除。
  • 校准每个容器，并确认校准完成。

docs.title: 机器组件
docs.text:
• 测试屏幕，并确认触摸有响应。
  • 测试网络连接。
  • 测试秤，并确认重量读数正确。
  • 测试扫描仪。
  • 测试声音。
  • 测试加热器（如已安装）。
  • 运行电机，并确认运行稳定。

docs.title: 配方和准确性
docs.text:
• 出料多个配方，并确认每个配方都成功完成。
  • 将每个配方的出料量与所需规格进行比较，并确认准确性。

docs.title: 补充原料
docs.text:
• 补充一个容器，并确认补充流程成功完成。
  • 确认机器已准备好发送到门店。

docs.title: 即将推出
docs.text:
经理文档将在此处添加。

计划涵盖以下主题：

  • 在网站中创建配方。
  • 在网站中创建商店。
  • 在网站中创建和管理原料。

docs.title: 手动出料
docs.text:
您可以手动出料指定数量的原料。

  1. 打开容器页面。
  2. 点击要出料的容器。容器详情会在侧边栏中打开。
  3. 选择或输入所需的重量，单位为克（g）。
  4. 将杯子放在出料口下方。 )
  5. 点击出料。
  6. 查看实时出料重量和最终准确度摘要。
  7. 如需中断流程，点击停止。

docs.title: 容器管理 (Pots Management) 文档
docs.text: 容器管理 (Pots Management) 功能允许您监控和管理存储在机器各个容器（Pots）中的原料。每个容器都分配有一个编号，并可以关联到特定的原料、加热以及手动分配。

docs.title: 📋 容器概览
docs.text: 容器 (Pots) 屏幕显示所有可用的容器。每个容器卡片显示： - 容器编号 (Pot Number)：容器的唯一标识符。 - 原料名称 (Ingredient Name)：关联原料的名称（如果已分配）。 - 填充液位 (Fill Level)：当前体积，以毫升 (ml) 为单位。 - 温度 (Temperature)：当前温度和目标温度（如果加热已激活）。 - 状态徽章 (Status Badges)：校准状态指示器（例如“未校准”、“陈旧”）或过期提醒。

docs.title: 🔗 绑定与解绑原料
docs.text: 要使用容器，必须将其与系统材料列表中的某种原料“绑定”。

docs.title: 绑定容器
docs.text:
1. 点击一个空容器（或未分配原料的容器）。
  2. 将出现可用材料/原料列表。
  3. 选择您希望链接到此容器的原料。
  4. 容器现在将显示原料名称和默认的过期设置。

docs.title: 解绑容器
docs.text:
1. 点击容器卡片上的 菜单图标（三个垂直点）。
  2. 选择 解绑容器 (Unbind Pot)。
  3. 确认操作。这将清除原料分配并重置填充液位。

docs.title: 🌡️ 温度控制
docs.text:
如果容器配备了加热器，您可以控制其温度。

  1. 点击容器卡片上的 温度图标（或通过容器菜单访问）。
  2. 使用滑块设置所需温度（通常在 10°C 到 40°C 之间）。
  3. 点击 设置 (Set) 开始加热。
  4. 您可以实时监控“当前温度”。
  5. 随时点击 停止 (Stop) 关闭加热器。

docs.title: 💧 填充与清空容器
docs.text: 跟踪原料液位以确保机器可以完成配方。

docs.title: 填充（加满）
docs.text:
1. 点击 菜单图标 并选择 填充 (Refill)（或者如果填充液位极低，直接点击容器）。
  2. 调整滑块以反映容器中的新总重量/体积。
  3. 点击 加满 (Top Up) 保存更改。机器可能会执行简短的初始化。

docs.title: 清空
docs.text:
1. 点击 菜单图标 并选择 清空 (Clear)。
  2. 这将把容器的当前填充液位重置为 0ml，表示其已空。

docs.title: ⚖️ 校准与维护
docs.text:
准确的分配取决于正确的校准。

  • 校准 (Calibrate)：如果容器显示“未校准”，您必须执行校准流程（通过菜单访问）以确保测量准确。
  • 重新计算回归 (Recalculate Regression)：高级维护选项，根据历史数据细化分配精度。
  • 重置错误 (Reset Errors)：如果容器多次遇到分配错误，在问题解决后，您可以通过菜单清除错误历史记录。

docs.title: 🧪 手动分配
docs.text:
您可以手动分配特定量的原料用于测试或自定义用途。

  1. 点击已绑定容器卡片的主体部分，打开 容器详情 (Pot Details) 屏幕。
  2. 选择或输入所需的重量（以克 (g) 为单位）。
  3. 确保在出料口下方放置一个杯子。
  4. 点击 出料 (Dispense)。
  5. 屏幕将显示实时出料的重量以及最终的精度摘要。
  6. 如果需要中断过程，请使用 停止 (Stop) 按钮。

docs.title: 配方和出料指南
docs.text: 本指南说明了如何使用 Mixer 应用中的配方和出料功能。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text: 配方功能允许您浏览可用配方，选择特定版本或大小，并启动自动出料过程。

docs.title: 配方列表
docs.text:
主屏幕显示所有可用配方。

所有可用配方的列表。

  • 类别：使用顶部的选项卡按类别筛选配方。
  • 配方卡片：每个配方显示其名称、唯一代码和类型。
  • 检查可用性：使用“检查可用性”按钮查看哪些配方可以使用机器当前加载的原料制作。

docs.title: 配方详情
docs.text:
选择配方会显示更多信息和准备选项。

配方详情和版本选择界面。

docs.title: 1. 版本选择
docs.text: 许多配方有不同的变体或大小。您可以选择所需的版本，所需的原料和总重量将自动更新。

docs.title: 2. 原料状态
docs.text: 如果出现以下情况，应用将发出警告： - 缺少任何原料。 - 某种原料剩余不足。 - 机器的出料口需要校准。

docs.title: 3. 原料列表
docs.text: 您可以查看所需的所有原料以及所选版本所需的确切数量。

docs.title: 4. 启动过程
docs.text:
• 开始出料：这将开始自动混合和出料过程。
  • 模式选择：根据机器设置，您可以在“快速”或“标准”出料模式之间进行选择。

docs.title: 出料过程
docs.text:
在机器工作时，您可以在屏幕上看到实时进度。机器处理每种原料的精确测量。如果发生任何问题，例如泵故障或原料耗尽，应用将立即通知您。

机器正在出料时的实时进度。

docs.title: 结果和完成
docs.text:
过程完成后，将显示摘要： - 状态：确认过程是否成功。 - 重量精度：显示实际出料量与目标重量的对比。 - 自动记录：机器会自动记录生产数据以供您参考。

显示结果和重量精度的完成摘要。

docs.title: 温度控制
docs.text:
如果容器配有加热器，您可以控制其温度。

  1. 点击容器卡片上的温度图标，或通过容器菜单访问。
  2. 使用滑块设置所需温度，通常为 10°C 至 40°C。

  3. 点击设置开始加热。

  4. 实时查看当前温度。

  5. 随时点击停止关闭加热器。
